name.description: The resource ID of the NAT address.
name.rationale: It sets the identifier of the NAT address and does not have any direct security impact.

instance_id.description: The Apigee instance associated with the NAT address.
instance_id.rationale: It sets the instance association and does not have any direct security impact.

activate.description: Flag that specifies whether the NAT address is activated so that the reserved address can be used for Internet egress traffic.
activate.rationale: An inactive NAT address means the reserved static IP is not in use for Internet egress traffic, wasting reserved IP resources and removing egress traffic control.
